sourceOfTruth: This JSON is the source of truth. The prose lens in skills/software-development/critic-lens-growth/SKILL.md is a human readable view; checklist-lint rejects duplicate IDs and SARIF ruleIds that do not resolve here. Missing or browser-only tracking is a real conversion gap.

items.title: Local business listing / social presence (if the site belongs to a local business): Google Business Profile completeness + currency

applicability.predicate: always unless the surface is absent, in which case record not-applicable with the absence as the reason

items.passCriteria: Evidence shows the check holds: Local business listing / social presence (if the site belongs to a local business): Google Business Profile completeness + currency, Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn presence, NAP consistency.
items.failCriteria: Evidence shows the check fails or no evidence is produced for: Local business listing / social presence (if the site belongs to a local business): Google Business Profile completeness + currency, Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn presence, NAP consistency.
items.howToTest: Inspect the artifact against: if the site belongs to a local business, verify the listing and presence surface directly, in this order: (1) open the Google Business Profile and compare name, address, phone, hours, and categories against the site field by field; (2) confirm the profile's newest photo is under 90 days old and its hours match the site's stated hours; (3) read the three most recent reviews and confirm each carries an owner response or a recorded reason it does not; (4) follow every linked social profile (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and confirm it resolves, carries the same name, address, and phone (NAP consistency), and shows a post inside the last 30 days; (5) record every disagreement between the site and the profiles as the finding, quoting both values. If the business is not a local business, record not-applicable with that reason. Never return the website verdict with this surface skipped and unrecorded.
